summary.en: The Pix BR Code payload behind a Pix QR Code and "Pix copia e cola".
summary.pt-BR: O payload BR Code por trás do QR Code Pix e do Pix copia e cola.

generate.summary: Generates the payload of a Pix BR Code, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola".
description: Generates a Pix BR Code payload; exactly one of a key (static) or a PSP URL (dynamic) must be given, otherwise returns null.
- `params` carries the key or URL, the merchant name and city, and optionally the amount, the txid and a description.

- A key is normalized as `pixKey.getInfo` does. A URL makes the payload dynamic (Point of Initiation `12`) and cannot carry an amount or txid; it is host and path without scheme, at most 77 characters.
- The amount has two decimal places; a value with more, or that rounds to 0.00, is rejected. The txid is 1 to 25 alphanumerics (default `***`).
- Merchant name, city and description lose their accents and are truncated to 25, 15 and what the template has left.

getInfo.summary: Parses a Pix BR Code payload, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola".
description: Parses a Pix BR Code payload into its fields; returns null for anything `pixPayload.isValid` rejects, never a partial result.
- Fields: merchant name and city, point of initiation (dynamic when there is a PSP location or object `01` is `12`, static otherwise) and either the key (static) or the URL (dynamic).
- Amount, txid, description and the withdrawal facilitator of a Pix Saque are present only when the payload carries them; the `***` txid marker means no txid.
- With a PSP location, amount and txid are ignored, as the manual mandates.

isValid.summary: Validates a Pix BR Code payload, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola".
description: Validates a Pix BR Code payload; the key itself is not checked (use `pixKey.isValid`).
- Checks the TLV structure, the CRC-16 and the mandatory objects (format indicator, category code, currency, country, merchant name and city).
- One Merchant Account Information template (IDs 26 to 51) must carry the `br.gov.bcb.pix` GUI with a key (static) or a PSP URL (dynamic), never both.
- Objects `01` and `62` are optional; `01` must be `11` or `12` when present. An amount (`54`) must be greater than zero, except in a Pix Saque.
